data.title: 黄泉 · 山间温泉
data.description: 山间浴室的窗半开着，黄泉穿着宽松长衫坐在木凳上，捧起热茶听外面的水声。
data.promptProse: Sitting on a smooth cypress stool beside the half-open slatted window of a secluded mountain bathhouse, Acheron sips green tea from a rough stoneware cup as dense mineral steam billows around her. Outside, cool night air ruffles bamboo groves under moonlight, while warm wooden tub reflections and soft lanterns envelope her in deep, peaceful recovery.
data.animaCaption: The half-open window lets in the sound of water.
